topic: How does defocused feed array placement optimize coverage versus scan loss in DBF architectures?
consensus_response: Defocused feed array placement optimizes coverage by reducing scan loss through averaging element patterns, but increases spillover and taper losses. Digital beamforming techniques mitigate these effects, minimizing non-uniform illumination losses and improving service availability and network efficiency.
reference_context: Defocused reflector concept reduces gain loss in feed failures, with scan loss calculated as 10 log(cos(θ0)) and average unit cell loss from simulation data.
